none: PAS NLM-C57267: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Tetricus II (272-274), Reece period 13, probably irregular issue; for reverse cf. Cunetio no. 2978. Obverse description: Radiate bust draped right. Obverse inscription: CAES TETRICVS. Reverse description: Female figure standing left with right arm extended: Laetitia. Reverse inscription: [LAETITIA]AVGG. Diameter: 16.2mm, Weight: 2.05gms, die axis: 2
